_help: The Wolfie Military arsenal. Change any number and rebuild. type: melee, flame, gun, projectile, sticky, mine, strike or blackhole. cooldown is seconds between shots; hold lets you keep the trigger down. radius is the size of the boom in blocks. speed is metres a second; gravity pulls shots down (20 is about normal). pierce is how many blocks a shot goes through. color is the colour of energy bolts. fuse is seconds before it blows (0 = when it hits). look is how a shot looks: ball, rocket, grenade, shell, charge, mine, bomb, meteor or drone. strike styles: artillery, jets, bomber, gunship, cruise, missiles, drones, meteors, mega, nuke. hand is what your character holds: tool, gun, launcher, charge, radio or alien.
